zh.headline: 苹果起诉 OpenAI 窃取硬件机密
zh.observation: 本周是生成式 AI 领域"超级发布周"的余震期。GPT-5.6 的发布不仅是模型能力的跃升，更以 Sol Ultra 解开 50 年数学猜想的方式，重新定义了"AI 能做科研"的边界。与此同时，苹果起诉 OpenAI 窃密、Meta 紧急关闭 AI 深度伪造功能、S&P 因 OpenAI 依赖下调 Oracle 评级——这三件事共同指向一个信号：AI 行业的"野蛮生长"阶段正在被法律、监管和商业风险所约束。对于 AI builder 而言，Agent token 消耗效率（Claude Code vs OpenCode 的 33k vs 7k 对比）和 GPU 利用率（86% 企业不足一半）才是当下最值得关注的务实问题。

items.title: 苹果起诉 OpenAI 窃取硬件机密
items.desc: 苹果向法院提起诉讼，指控 OpenAI 系统性窃取其硬件核心机密，包括机密演示文稿、原型和供应商细节，并称该行为由 OpenAI 高管层直接指使。
items.value: AI 行业人才流动与知识产权冲突升级为法律战

items.title: OpenAI 推出 ChatGPT Work：云端自主工作 Agent
items.desc: OpenAI 发布 ChatGPT Work，一款嵌入 ChatGPT 的云端 AI Agent，可跨邮件、日历、Slack 和代码仓库执行复杂多步任务，由 GPT-5.6 驱动。
items.value: ChatGPT 从问答工具进化为自主工作平台

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 一小时解开 50 年数学猜想
items.desc: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra 利用 64 个子 Agent 并行工作，在一小时内生成了 Cycle Double Cover Conjecture 的证明，该猜想已悬而未决 50 年。
items.value: 展示大规模 Agent 协作在数学推理上的突破性能力

items.title: Meta 紧急关闭 Instagram AI 深度伪造功能
items.desc: Meta 在推出 Muse Image 功能数天后即将其关闭，该功能允许用户通过 @提及公开 Instagram 账户来生成 AI 图像，无需对方同意即引发巨大争议。
items.value: AI 产品隐私边界失控的典型案例

items.title: Anthropic 澄清：Claude 变笨是用户误解
items.desc: Anthropic 官方回应近期用户抱怨 Claude 变笨的舆论，指出问题不在于模型本身，而在于用户对模型能力边界和配置方式的误解。
items.value: 提醒开发者：模型能力受限于使用方式而非单纯模型大小

items.title: S&P 下调 Oracle 信用评级，OpenAI 是关键风险
items.desc: S&P Global 将 Oracle 信用评级下调至 "BBB-"，距垃圾级仅一步之遥。OpenAI 占 Oracle 6380 亿美元合同负债的近一半，若 OpenAI 离开，Oracle 将面临大量数据中心产能闲置。
items.value: 揭示 AI 巨头对云厂商的单一客户依赖风险

items.title: DeepSeek 降价 75%，但 "100 倍问题" 依然存在
items.desc: DeepSeek 将 V4-Pro 模型价格大幅下调 75%，但企业发现更便宜的模型并不自动转化为更高的利润率——Agent 系统消耗 token 的速度远超价格下降的速度。
items.value: 推理成本下降被 Agent 的 token 消耗速度抵消

items.title: 86% 企业 GPU 利用率不足一半
items.desc: VentureBeat 对 573 位技术领导者的调查显示，86% 的企业 GPU 运行在半容量或更低水平，企业正在为过度部署 GPU 而进行事后补救。
items.value: GPU 投资与实际利用率之间存在巨大鸿沟

items.title: Claude Code 现在内置浏览器，可自主操作外部网站
items.desc: Claude Code 新增内置浏览器功能，AI 可以直接在开发环境中打开、阅读和交互外部网页，写操作需用户批准。
items.value: AI 编程助手从代码编辑扩展到全 Web 操作

items.title: OpenAI 安全负责人离职
items.desc: OpenAI 安全负责人 Johannes Heidecke 宣布离职，正值公司试图进一步整合其研究和安全团队之际。
items.value: AI 安全领导层持续动荡的信号

items.title: Fidji Simo 辞去 OpenAI 二号人物职务
items.desc: OpenAI AGI 部署负责人 Fidji Simo 因医疗假超出预期，辞去全职职务转为兼职顾问，正值公司考虑 IPO 并在企业市场追赶 Anthropic 的关键时期。
items.value: OpenAI 高层持续流失，IPO 在即面临领导真空

items.title: Google TabFM：无需逐数据集训练的表格基础模型
items.desc: Google Research 提出 TabFM，将表格预测视为上下文学习问题，无需为每个数据集重新训练即可在未见过的表格上生成预测。
items.value: 彻底改变表格数据建模方式，降低部署成本

items.title: Google SensorFM：万亿分钟传感器数据预训练的可穿戴健康基础模型
items.desc: Google Research 与 DeepMind 联合发布 SensorFM，基于 ViT-1D 掩码自编码器，在 500 万参与者的超过 1 万亿分钟未标注传感器信号上预训练。
items.value: 可穿戴健康 AI 的 "ImageNet 时刻"，大幅降低下游任务数据需求

items.title: 线性注意力架构的机制、权衡与跨层路由
items.desc: 论文对 softmax 注意力与四种线性注意力架构（DeltaNet、Gated DeltaNet、Kimi Delta Attention、Gated DeltaNet-2）进行了系统比较研究，用统一的循环记忆符号表达其差异。
items.value: 为长上下文模型架构选择提供系统性参考

items.title: AgentLens：生产评估的编程 Agent 轨迹评测基准
items.desc: AgentLens 不仅评估任务是否通过，还评估 Agent 的完整执行轨迹，包括指令遵循、工具使用、自我验证、错误恢复和与用户的交互质量。
items.value: 填补了现有 Agent 评测只关注 "是否通过" 的空缺

items.title: Proactive Memory Agent：面向长周期任务的主动记忆系统
items.desc: 论文提出将记忆作为主动干预机制而非被动检索，通过独立的记忆 Agent 在决策相关状态即将被遗忘时主动注入上下文。
items.value: 解决长周期 Agent 的 "行为状态衰减" 问题

items.title: Jet-Long：动态双焦 RoPE 实现高效长上下文扩展
items.desc: 提出 Dynamic Bifocal RoPE，一种零样本长上下文扩展方法，可动态调整缩放因子，避免激进缩放牺牲短上下文保真度的问题。
items.value: 零样本长上下文扩展的实用方案，对开源模型部署有直接帮助

items.title: OPSD-V：自回归视频生成器的自蒸馏后训练范式
items.desc: 提出在策略自蒸馏方法，用于后训练少步自回归视频扩散模型，减少长自回归 rollout 中的误差累积和运动退化。
items.value: 降低长视频生成的误差累积，提升生成质量

items.title: AI Agent 在 Slay the Spire 2 中获胜：结构化记忆替代聊天日志
items.desc: AgenticSTS 项目用五层分离记忆替换不断增长的聊天日志，将提示词稳定在 5000 tokens 而非膨胀至 50 万 tokens，Agent 在 10 局游戏中获胜 6 局。
items.value: 结构化记忆设计可显著提升 Agent 在复杂游戏中的表现

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.desc: 个人交易 Agent 框架，今日 GitHub 涨星 776+。
items.value: AI 驱动的个人交易 Agent 开源实现

items.title: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.desc: 100+ 可实际运行的 AI Agent 和 RAG 应用集合，今日涨星 450+。
items.value: 可直接克隆定制的 LLM 应用宝库

items.title: Dicklesworthstone/destructive_command_guard
items.desc: 阻止 Agent 执行危险 git 和 shell 命令的安全防护工具，今日涨星 444+。
items.value: 解决 AI Agent 安全执行命令的关键痛点

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.desc: 为 Claude Code、Cursor 和 Codex 提供反 AI 垃圾设计技能，今日涨星 210+。
items.value: 提升 AI 生成代码/内容的质量控制

items.title: steipete/CodexBar
items.desc: 无需登录即可显示 OpenAI Codex 和 Claude Code 使用统计的菜单栏工具。
items.value: 轻量级使用监控，对 Codex/Claude Code 用户实用

items.title: Claude Code vs OpenCode 的 token 开销对比引发热议
items.desc: HN 上 372 分讨论指出 Claude Code 在读取提示前先发送 33k tokens，而开源替代 OpenCode 仅发送 7k tokens。社区质疑 Anthropic 的 token 效率策略，认为这种"先发制人"的上下文加载方式在长期使用中会造成显著浪费。

items.title: Sam Altman 改口：AI 净创造就业
items.desc: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman 现称"相当确定"AI 创造的就业多于其消灭的岗位，与他早前关于整个职业消失的警告形成鲜明对比。Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 也在收回类似言论。社区对此反应不一——有观点认为这是为 IPO 铺路的公关话术，也有人指出目前尚无研究支持任何一方。

en.headline: Apple Sues OpenAI Alleging Theft of Hardware Trade Secrets
en.observation: This week is the aftershock period of generative AI's "super launch week." GPT-5.6's release isn't just a model capability leap—Sol Ultra solving a 50-year-old math conjecture redefines the boundary of "AI doing research." Meanwhile, Apple suing OpenAI over theft, Meta shutting down AI deepfakes, and S&P downgrading Oracle over OpenAI dependency—these three events together signal that AI's "wild west" phase is being constrained by legal, regulatory, and business risks. For AI builders, the most pragmatic concerns right now are agent token consumption efficiency (Claude Code's 33k vs OpenCode's 7k) and GPU utilization (86% of enterprises below half capacity).

items.title: Apple Sues OpenAI Alleging Theft of Hardware Trade Secrets
items.desc: Apple filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging systematic theft of its core hardware secrets including confidential presentations, prototypes, and supplier details, claiming the misconduct was directed by OpenAI's senior leadership.
items.value: Talent mobility and IP conflicts in AI escalate to legal warfare

items.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Work: Cloud-Based Autonomous Agent
items.desc: OpenAI released ChatGPT Work, an AI agent embedded in ChatGPT that executes complex multi-step tasks across email, calendars, Slack, and code repositories, powered by GPT-5.6.
items.value: ChatGPT evolves from Q&A tool to autonomous work platform

items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra Solves 50-Year-Old Math Conjecture in One Hour
items.desc: OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produced a proof of the Cycle Double Cover Conjecture in under an hour using 64 subagents working in parallel, a problem unsolved for 50 years.
items.value: Demonstrates breakthrough capability of large-scale agent collaboration in mathematical reasoning

items.title: Meta Shuts Down Instagram AI Deepfake Feature After Backlash
items.desc: Meta removed its Muse Image feature days after launch, which let users generate AI images by @-mentioning public Instagram accounts without consent, sparking massive controversy.
items.value: Textbook case of AI product privacy boundaries gone wrong

items.title: Anthropic Clarifies: Claude Getting Dumber is User Misunderstanding
items.desc: Anthropic officially responded to recent user complaints about Claude becoming less capable, stating the issue lies not with the model itself but with user misunderstanding of model capability boundaries and configuration.
items.value: Reminder that model capability is limited by usage patterns, not just model size

items.title: S&P Downgrades Oracle Credit Rating, OpenAI is Key Risk
items.desc: S&P Global cut Oracle's credit rating to "BBB-", one notch above junk. OpenAI accounts for roughly half of Oracle's $638 billion in contractual obligations. If OpenAI walked away, Oracle would face massive idle data center capacity.
items.value: Reveals single-customer dependency risk of AI giants on cloud providers

items.title: DeepSeek Cuts Prices 75%, But the 100x Problem Remains
items.desc: DeepSeek slashed V4-Pro pricing by 75%, but enterprises find cheaper models don't translate to healthier margins—agent systems consume tokens faster than prices decline.
items.value: Inference cost savings offset by agent token consumption velocity

items.title: 86% of Enterprises Run GPUs at Half Capacity or Less
items.desc: VentureBeat survey of 573 technical leaders shows 86% of enterprise GPUs run at half capacity or lower, with companies retrofitting to catch up with their own over-deployment.
items.value: Massive gap between GPU investment and actual utilization

items.title: Claude Code Now Has Built-in Browser for External Website Interaction
items.desc: Claude Code added a built-in browser feature that lets AI open, read, and interact with external web pages directly in the development environment, with write actions requiring user approval.
items.value: AI coding assistant expands from code editing to full web operations

items.title: OpenAI Head of Safety Departs
items.desc: OpenAI's head of safety Johannes Heidecke announced his departure as the company tries to further integrate its research and safety teams.
items.value: Signals continued leadership instability in AI safety

items.title: Fidji Simo Steps Down as OpenAI's No. 2 Executive
items.desc: OpenAI's AGI deployment chief Fidji Simo is leaving her full-time role due to extended medical leave, transitioning to part-time advisor at a critical time as the company eyes an IPO and races to catch Anthropic in enterprise.
items.value: Continued executive churn at OpenAI amid IPO preparations

items.title: Google TabFM: Table Foundation Model Without Per-Dataset Training
items.desc: Google Research proposes TabFM that treats tabular prediction as an in-context learning problem, generating predictions on unseen tables without retraining for each dataset.
items.value: Fundamentally changes tabular data modeling, reduces deployment cost

items.title: Google SensorFM: Wearable Health Foundation Model Pretrained on Trillion Minutes of Sensor Data
items.desc: Google Research and DeepMind jointly release SensorFM, a ViT-1D masked-autoencoder pretrained on over 1 trillion minutes of unlabeled sensor signals from 5 million consented participants.
items.value: "ImageNet moment" for wearable health AI, drastically reduces downstream data needs

items.title: Linear Attention Architectures: Mechanisms, Trade-offs, and Cross-Layer Routing
items.desc: Systematic comparative study of softmax attention and four linear-attention architectures (DeltaNet, Gated DeltaNet, Kimi Delta Attention, Gated DeltaNet-2), expressed in a common recurrent-memory notation.
items.value: Provides systematic reference for long-context model architecture selection

items.title: AgentLens: Production-Assessed Trajectory Reviews for Coding Agent Evaluation
items.desc: AgentLens evaluates not just task pass/fail but the complete agent trajectory including instruction following, tool use, self-verification, error recovery, and interaction quality.
items.value: Fills gap in agent evaluation that only checks "did it pass"

items.title: Proactive Memory Agent for Long-Horizon Agents
items.desc: Proposes memory as an active intervention mechanism rather than passive retrieval, with a separate memory agent that proactively injects decision-relevant state when it's about to be forgotten.
items.value: Solves "behavioral state decay" problem in long-horizon agents

items.title: Jet-Long: Dynamic Bifocal RoPE for Efficient Long-Context Extension
items.desc: Proposes Dynamic Bifocal RoPE, a zero-shot long-context extension method that dynamically adjusts scaling factors to avoid sacrificing short-context fidelity.
items.value: Practical zero-shot long-context extension, directly useful for open-source model deployment

items.title: OPSD-V: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Few-Step Autoregressive Video Generators
items.desc: Proposes on-policy self-distillation paradigm for post-training few-step autoregressive video diffusion models, reducing error accumulation and motion degradation during long autoregressive rollout.
items.value: Reduces error accumulation in long video generation, improves quality

items.title: AI Agents Win at Slay the Spire 2: Structured Memory Replaces Chat Logs
items.desc: AgenticSTS project replaces ever-growing chat logs with five separate memory layers, keeping prompts at ~5,000 tokens instead of ballooning past 500,000. Agent wins 6 out of 10 games.
items.value: Structured memory design significantly improves agent performance in complex games

items.title: HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
items.desc: Personal trading agent framework, +776 stars on GitHub today.
items.value: Open-source implementation of AI-driven personal trading agent

items.title: Shubhamsaboo/awesome-llm-apps
items.desc: Collection of 100+ runnable AI Agent and RAG apps, +450 stars today.
items.value: Ready-to-clone-and-customize LLM application treasure trove

items.title: Dicklesworthstone/destructive_command_guard
items.desc: Security tool blocking dangerous git and shell commands from being executed by agents, +444 stars today.
items.value: Addresses critical pain point of safe AI agent command execution

items.title: Nutlope/hallmark
items.desc: Anti-AI-slop design skill for Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex, +210 stars today.
items.value: Improves quality control of AI-generated code/content

items.title: steipete/CodexBar
items.desc: Menu bar tool showing usage stats for OpenAI Codex and Claude Code without login.
items.value: Lightweight usage monitoring, practical for Codex/Claude Code users

items.title: Claude Code vs OpenCode token overhead comparison sparks heated debate
items.desc: A 372-point HN discussion reveals Claude Code sends 33k tokens before reading the prompt, while open-source alternative OpenCode sends only 7k tokens. The community questions Anthropic's token efficiency strategy, arguing this "preemptive" context loading wastes significant tokens over long usage sessions.

items.title: Sam Altman Reverses: AI is Net Job-Creating
items.desc: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman now says he's "pretty sure" AI has created more jobs than eliminated, a sharp pivot from his earlier warnings about entire professions disappearing. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei is walking back similar claims. Community reactions are mixed—some see it as IPO PR spin, others note no studies support either side yet.
